title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 8. und 9. Mai 2026

extraction.placeName: Sowjetische Ehrenmale (Treptower Park, Tiergarten, Schönholzer Heide)
extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a general order restricting certain symbols, uniforms and songs around Soviet war memorials in Treptow-Köpenick, Mitte and Pankow for 8–9 May 2026. The order is an official notice, not a specific incident.
